Deliveries time out when HTTPS_PROXY points at http://svc-proxy:pr0xyS3cretValue@proxy.corp.example.com:3128
and the request is sent with `PRIVATE-TOKEN: example-deploy-secret`.

Expected: the sender honours NO_PROXY and retries once through the direct route.
